title: Each type's level is a property of the type; the cell's hold is the slow-write rule; the chain's sequencing instruments read again
set_out: Find what sets each cell type's own level (A8) on spent data, with the simulator first; get every sequencing instrument reading on the spent atlas libraries; keep the records consolidated and lose nothing.
open_at_turnover: Which side moves in A8 beyond the eraser's share (restore delivery or passive loss); an outside per-type measure of how much of the time a type is being ordered; a usable per-CpG 5hmC source for neurons; the 12 libraries made readable by E2c stay unread; the full spent-data run.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: Unused atlas libraries through the one button (A8DER)
entries.what: 49 atlas libraries never read before, one reading each.
entries.outcome: 20 of 22 banded readings inside their type band; 19 refused as mixtures until routing step E2c.

entries.title: Mixture routing by tissue family (chain overhaul E2c; COM-IAMA-054)
entries.what: Non-blood atlas cells pooled by tissue family in the mixture check.
entries.outcome: On main; atlas inputs stay single; the planted blood mixture stays mixed.
entries.reference: IAM Sequencing Atlas (development); purity check of 154 sorted atlas libraries

entries.title: Globe, information sphere and C-Score sky on sorted sequencing files (PHY-035)
entries.what: A specimen naming no cell takes the sample's own Deconvolver shares; the sky plate is drawn on sequencing.
entries.outcome: On main; were refused in 152 of 156 readings.
entries.reference: IAM Sequencing Atlas (development), the sample's own Deconvolver shares

entries.title: The cell's hold as the slow-write rule (PHY-083)
entries.what: Symbolic check that the driven-passage odds equal the kept-over-lost ratio of a slow write.
entries.outcome: Confirmed; book, Decoder, physics root and simulator note updated.
entries.reference: no atlas: a symbolic identity; the cell simulator's canon level 0.04454 (IAM Sequencing Atlas held reference)

sections.heading: What we learned that we did not know yesterday

entries.title: Each type's level belongs to the type
entries.what: No donor effect and no age effect across 152 libraries; unseen donors land in their type's band.
entries.outcome: The bands cannot be narrowed by a donor correction.

sections.heading: Our own mistakes and what caught them

entries.title: A rule attributed to the author that he never gave
entries.what: The agent set published division counts aside citing a 'rule' of the author's; the author caught it.
entries.outcome: Corrected in the register and memory; the counts are used.
